name: How should I prepare my cabin before interior sealing begins?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my cabin before interior sealing begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before the crew arrives, clear furniture, rugs, and wall hangings at least three to four feet away from log walls and timber beams. Identify areas where you have felt drafts, noticed pest entry, or seen loose previous sealants so you can point them out during the walk-through. If your cabin incorporates blended finishes—such as drywall partitions, tile backsplashes, or custom finish carpentry—note where those surfaces intersect with logs. HH Remodeling protects existing flooring and furnishings with drop cloths, but providing clear floor space speeds up setup and joint tooling.
acceptedAnswer.description: Move furniture away from exterior-facing walls, take down hanging decor, and note drafty or cracked joints to show your contractor during the walkthrough.
